title: Halloween at Coaster Parks in 2026
h1: Halloween 2026 across the coaster parks: haunt nights and family days
description: Compare confirmed 2026 haunt dates, daytime Halloween events, admission rules and maze passes across the parks we cover.
summary: The 2026 Halloween calendar spans separate-ticket haunts, four Six Flags Fright Fests with paid maze access, and family daytime programs. These events serve different ages and budgets, so the date and ticket combination matter as much as the park.
typicalWindow: Mid-September through early November on select dates; confirm each park’s operating calendar

sections.heading: What admission covers
body: The four Six Flags Fright Fests run with regular park admission or an eligible pass on scheduled nights. A Haunted Attractions Pass is required for their mazes. Six Flags Over Texas also requires that pass for the new Doc Varnum’s Hybrid Hell Pit scare zone.

Knott’s Scary Farm and SeaWorld's Orlando and San Diego Howl-O-Scream events sell separate evening tickets. SeaWorld San Antonio includes Howl-O-Scream with park admission on scheduled dates. If mazes are your main goal, include the Six Flags maze pass when comparing costs.

sections.heading: Family daytime and evening scares
body: Magic Mountain and Over Texas run Tricks and Treats; Great Adventure and Great America run Kids Boo Fest. These are daytime activities with treat trails and family entertainment on scheduled dates.

Six Flags does not recommend Fright Fest for children under 13. Magic Mountain lists its daytime event from noon to 5 p.m. and Fright Fest from 6:30 p.m. to closing on specified dates; other parks publish their own schedules.

sections.heading: Use the actual 2026 calendar
body: Magic Mountain Fright Fest runs September 18 through November 1 on specified nights, including several Thursdays in October. Over Texas begins September 11, Great Adventure September 18 and Great America September 19; all four end November 1 on select nights.
The date range does not mean daily operation. Check the official park calendar for the exact date, closing time, showtime, maze availability and ride closures before making a plan.

southern-california.verdict: The deepest Halloween region on this site: the flagship haunt, a strong SeaWorld haunt, the biggest Fright Fest and the family event, all within two hours.
southern-california.note: Magic Mountain runs Tricks and Treats by day and Fright Fest at night on specified dates. Knott’s Scary Farm, SeaWorld San Diego and LEGOLAND California offer different ticket and intensity choices.

texas.verdict: Over Texas offers family activities by day and Fright Fest on select nights; SeaWorld San Antonio includes Howl-O-Scream with park admission on scheduled dates.
texas.note: Over Texas pairs daytime Tricks and Treats with select-night Fright Fest; mazes and one new scare zone need a Haunted Attractions Pass.

orlando.verdict: Howl-O-Scream is the value play in the Halloween capital — the same produced-haunt ambition as the resort events, usually cheaper, with better coasters running after dark.
orlando.note: Orlando's Halloween season is a three-way contest with the Disney and Universal events; the SeaWorld haunt is the coaster fan's pick of the three.

new-jersey.verdict: Great Adventure has Kids Boo Fest for families by day and Fright Fest for older scare fans on select nights.
new-jersey.note: Great Adventure’s daytime Kids Boo Fest begins September 12; its Fright Fest starts September 18 on select nights, with a separate maze pass.

chicago.verdict: Great America's Fright Fest is the region's default Halloween park night, with the lake wind as its signature special effect.
chicago.note: Great America offers weekend Kids Boo Fest and select-night Fright Fest from September 19 to November 1; haunted mazes require a separate pass.

faqs.q: Which Halloween event is best for young kids?
faqs.a: Daytime options include Tricks and Treats at Magic Mountain and Over Texas, Kids Boo Fest at Great Adventure and Great America, and Brick-or-Treat at LEGOLAND California. Confirm each park’s date-specific schedule.

faqs.q: Are Six Flags Fright Fest mazes included?
faqs.a: No. In 2026 the four Six Flags parks on this site require a Haunted Attractions Pass for maze entry. General admission covers each park's included scare zones and shows on scheduled nights, but Six Flags Over Texas also requires the pass for Doc Varnum’s Hybrid Hell Pit scare zone. Check the selected park's terms.

faqs.q: When do the 2026 Fright Fests run?
faqs.a: Magic Mountain and Great Adventure begin September 18, Over Texas begins September 11 and Great America begins September 19. All four list November 1 as the last date, but operate only on select nights in between.

faqs.q: Is a Halloween date range an operating calendar?
faqs.a: No. A start and end date bracket select event days or nights. Consult the official park calendar for your exact date, especially when planning a Thursday, a weekday or a trip with young children.

freshness.sourceNote: Checked September 26, 2026 against the official 2026 event pages for Six Flags Magic Mountain, Over Texas, Great Adventure and Great America. Dates, admission rules and daytime programs appear in their linked event records with source URLs.
